"""behavior.py — note.detail: read one note and its tag names.

Read only against the kernel: no data is ever mutated here.
"""

from kernel import AppError, require_session


def _validate_note_id(note_id):
    """Raise INVALID_PARAMETER when note_id is missing or empty."""
    if not note_id:
        raise AppError("INVALID_PARAMETER")


def _load_note(store, note_id):
    """Raise NOT_FOUND when no note has that id."""
    note = store.note(note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND")
    return note


def _tag_names_for(store, note_id):
    """Names of the tags on a note, ordered by name ascending."""
    names = [
        tag["name"]
        for tag in store.tags()
        if tag.get("note_id") == note_id
    ]
    names.sort()
    return names


def note_detail(store, session, note_id=None):
    require_session(session)
    _validate_note_id(note_id)

    note = _load_note(store, note_id)
    tags = _tag_names_for(store, note_id)

    return {
        "id": note["id"],
        "title": note.get("title", ""),
        "body": note.get("body", ""),
        "archived": bool(note.get("archived", False)),
        "tags": tags,
    }
